LESSON: SHIRK OF SHIRK SHIRK

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Shirk of Shirk Shirk

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Shirk of Shirk Shirk
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should a Muslim avoid shirk?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain different types of shirk to avoid associating Allah with other beings
2. describe different ways through which shirk is manifested to protect one’s Iman
3. practise acts that are devoid of shirk in daily life
4. recognise the belief in One God as the foundation of Iman
